title: MPGN classification & etiology
guide: Mesangiocapillary eponym; the Type I vs Type II (C3 GN) table: IF patterns (IgG+IgM±C3 vs C3±IgG/M), 80% vs 100% transplant recurrence, 100% secondary banner, monoclonal (plasma cell dyscrasias, CLL) vs polyclonal causes (HCV/endocarditis/leprosy/P. malariae; VP shunt; SLE/Sjogren's/scleroderma; lipodystrophy + optic drusen), and EM deposit sites with dense-deposit eponym.

title: MPGN features, presentation, prognosis & IgA intro
guide: LM triad (capillary thickening, mesangial > endocapillary proliferation, lobular tuft ± uniform nodules) with figure label, 35/35/20/10 presentation split, 100% → CKD prognosis, HCV extrahepatic note (PCT, lichen planus, Sjogrens, cryoglobulinemia → non-thrombocytopenic palpable purpura), then IgA eponyms (Henoch-Schonlein/Berger's, m/c glomerular disease) and mIgA/pIgA biology.

title: IgA secondary causes & innocent bystander mechanism
guide: Mucosal injury list (coeliac, Whipple, tropical sprue, Crohns, UC; HIV → collapsing FSGS), cirrhosis clearance failure, spondyloarthritis examples with CD > UC, the innocent bystander chain (galactose-deficient pIgA → anti-glycan antibodies → large complex → hepatic vein → IVC → aqueous misdirected filtration → mesangial deposit), and the liver-disease/m/c-glomerular-disease table.

title: IgA presentation & prognosis
guide: Males > females; >50% adolescent synpharyngitic episodic macrohematuria with intervening microhematuria+proteinuria; 30-40% asymptomatic; 1% RPGN (adult HSP); 5% NS; 5% straight-to-CKD (HTN, ↑Cr, contracted kidney); rule of 1/3; MEST-C bad-prognosis set (extra-mesangial IgA, non-mesangial proliferation, non-IgA deposits, endocapillary hypercellularity, segmental sclerosis/tubular atrophy, crescents); macrohematuria good prognosis; C3/C4 and serum IgA no value.

title: IgA investigations & treatment ladder
guide: Pure mesangioproliferative LM and pIgA1 ± C3 IF; conservative targets (<2 g Na+/day, 1 g/kg/day protein, BP <140/90, ACEi/ARBs); short-course steroid indications (6-month >1 g/day, NS, RPGN crescents, high E score, no significant CKD; GFR ≤30 → none); transplant if CKD with ↓ recurrence.

title: Complement patterns & IgA-deposit conditions
guide: Complement tree (C3↓+C4↓ classical e.g. MPGN I; transiently low C3 e.g. PSGN; ↓C3 normal C4 alternate e.g. C3GN/adult HUS) and the IgA-deposit list (IgA nephropathy, IgA-predominant adult PSGN, full house SLE, light chain deposition disease IgA & κ part of myeloma).
